preview.ebooks.notice.chaptersShown.comment: Limits-strip sentence for a truncated e-book (EPUB): how many of its chapters the preview shows. Plural: the first argument selects the form by the number of chapters shown; %2$@ prints that number and %3$@ the total number of chapters in the book, both formatted for the display locale, so no variant carries digits. Both numbers come from the e-book adapter's own chapter list, never from the displayed text; the last chapter shown can be cut short. Describes only what this preview shows and says nothing about which app Finder uses. All translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.

notebook.output.figureInPages.comment: One inert line in a rendered Jupyter notebook, under an output whose saved picture is shown in the Pages mode instead (replaces the line "Output not shown" for that picture). Formatted: %1$@ is the figure's number, formatted for the display locale, matching the label "Figure n of m" in Pages. "Pages" is the name of the preview mode (the key preview.mode.pages): keep it consistent with that word and inflect it as the sentence needs. Never describes the picture's content. No plural: the number is a position, not a quantity. All translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.
